video_summary.overall_goal: Search for a hostname in the blocklist and add it
video_summary.description: User opens Adaway app, taps search field, types hostname, interacts with search results

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Adaway main screen with blocklist stats (81180 entries), three category cards, and bottom navigation
visible_ui_elements: Bottom navigation: Hosts, Ad Filters, My Lists
steps.visual_feedback: Red FAB button visible at bottom right

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Search field with placeholder 'Search hostname...' appears at top, keyboard opens
visible_ui_elements: Search input field with placeholder text
steps.system_response: Search field focused, keyboard opens, cursor active in field
steps.visual_feedback: Cursor blinking in search field, keyboard displayed
steps.intent_task: Open search interface for hostname lookup

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Search field contains text 'udn' (partial hostname entry). Keyboard remains visible with multiple key presses
steps.system_response: Text accumulates in search field character by character
steps.visual_feedback: Text appears in search field, keyboard keys highlight as pressed

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Keyboard is closing/dismissing. Search field still shows 'udn'. UI transitions toward collapsed keyboard state
visible_ui_elements: Bottom navigation bar area becoming visible

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Back to Adaway home screen. Search interface has closed. Original blocklist stats visible
steps.system_response: Search screen dismissed, returns to main screen
steps.visual_feedback: Smooth screen transition back to home
steps.intent_task: Exit search, return to main view

overall_flow: Tap search field to open search interface
Type partial hostname 'udn' into search field
human_readable_step_summary: Adaway home screen displays blocklist statistics and navigation options.
User taps search field to open hostname search interface.
User types 'udn' as search query character by character.
User dismisses on-screen keyboard after completing text entry.
User returns to home screen by pressing back button.
